issues.description: The problem statement and UML require the Lecture constructor parameters to follow the attribute order from the UML (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution implementation defines the constructor with a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch can confuse students about the expected constructor signature and cause tests or example usage that rely on the UML order to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor in the solution to use the UML-specified parameter order: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... } Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to match the constructor order used in the solution if that order was intended.

issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies the constructor parameter order as lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, but the provided solution implements a constructor with a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch between the problem specification and the solution creates a mapping barrier: students expecting the UML order may pass arguments in that order and find the reference implementation uses a different arrangement, causing confusion about which parameter corresponds to which attribute.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the constructor signature in the solution (and template) with the UML/order in the problem statement. Use: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields accordingly (this.numberOfInscribedStudents = numberOfInscribedStudents; this.numberOfGuestStudents = numberOfGuestStudents; this.numberOfLecturers = numberOfLecturers; this.numberOfTutors = numberOfTutors;).
